key_catalyst: Memory/storage chip stocks plunge 8-9% on supercycle doubts, coupled with CENTCOM strikes on Iran driving oil above $85
reasoning: A sector-wide memory/storage chip rout (Micron -8%, SK Hynix -9%) is a novel negative catalyst heavily weighing on QQQ, while escalating US-Iran strikes and oil above $85 rekindle the risk-off dynamic that drove a -1.90% QQQ drop on July 13. Despite offsets from TSMC's blowout earnings and Apple's all-time high, the severity and novelty of the memory supercycle doubts, combined with an unresolved geopolitical escalation, signal that downside is not fully absorbed.
